correctness.rationale: The unweighted path on p−1 sites has spectrum ±a_i, a_i=2 cos(πi/p)>0 for 1≤i≤(p−1)/2, with nonzero endpoint sine weight at every eigenvalue. Restricting Uτ to the endpoint cyclic subspace C leaves one vector per distinct sampled phase. Q=(I_C−P)Uτ has norm ≤1 and no eigenvalue of modulus 1: equality of norms under projection would give a Uτ eigenvector orthogonal to the endpoint in C, impossible. Thus Q^t→0 and detection is almost sure. The no-detection probability after t steps is ||Q^tψ||²; tracing the telescoping sum generated by QQ†=I_C−P gives its total over t≥0 as dim(C), the mean measurement count. For rational independence, the vanishing polynomial in RESULT.md lines 43–51 has degree ≤p−1 and zero middle coefficient, whereas the minimal polynomial Φ₂ₚ of ζ=e^(πi/p) has degree p−1 and a nonzero middle coefficient. All relation coefficients must vanish. The positive energy gaps have nonproportional distinct coefficient vectors 2e_i, e_i+e_j, e_i−e_j (i<j for the last two); different vectors cannot give rationally related gaps. At any positive sampling time only one gap magnitude may resonate, with one opposite-energy pair for 2a_i and two disjoint pairs for each of the sum and difference types; off-ladder there is no collision. This gives m² disjoint ladders and the stated counts, with the two-pair branch empty at p=3. The frozen floating-point checks (220 ladder representatives and 43 Lyapunov means) were inspected in verify.py and VERIFICATION.md, not run; they do not certify nonoverlap at arbitrary multiples or unbounded sizes.

evidence: Godsil et al. cover independence for prime, twice-prime and power-of-two values of n+1, including this n=p−1; the relevant graph is the open path.

Grünbaum et al. apply to the spectral measure of any recurrent unitary pair; finite spectral support gives recurrence and mean as above. Sinkovicz et al. give a general unital open-system dimension rule. Riddell–Bertini's independent periodic/hopping spectra differ from this model.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The general counting rule alone would not classify the gaps, and the periodic hopping example does not establish independence here. The actual same-path theorem supplies exactly the missing input; no composite-length classification or other model is attributed to the frozen result.

evidence: In the prior independent basis, the signed energies are represented by ±e_i. Their positive differences are represented by 2e_i and e_i±e_j for i<j. The first has one contributing pair, and each other vector has two contributing pairs with disjoint endpoints. None of the distinct vectors is rationally proportional to another.

Hence the corresponding ladders are automatically disjoint, number m+2·binom(m,2)=m², and collapse respectively one or two atoms of the prior mean-return formula. Nonresonant times preserve all p−1 atoms; for m=1 there are no two-index differences.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: This explicitly derives the full stated finding, not just integer quantization. The only steps after inserting the prior path theorem in the prior measurement theorem are the signed-coordinate subtraction and counting the resulting equalities. The alternate proofs of independence and recurrence in the frozen manuscript do not make the exact invariant distinct under the review standard.

The path-transfer article takes θ_r=2 cos(πr/(n+1)) and states that the positive eigenvalues are linearly independent over Q when n=p−1 (as well as two other length families). These are exactly the frozen a_r.

Together the two statements convert the target to counting differences of a known independent signed basis.

exact_database_or_table.reasoning: Finite tables of numerical phases cannot decide the all-prime, all-positive-time statement. None of these model-specific examples is being counted as exact table coverage; the decisive evidence is the theorem-level implication.

originality.rationale: The exact three-branch formula was not found printed as such. It is nevertheless mechanically implied by two prior results on the very hypotheses needed: Godsil–Kirkland–Severini–Smith explicitly establish rational independence of the positive eigenvalues of this same path P_{p−1}, and Grünbaum–Velázquez–Werner–Werner give recurrence and mean equal to the number of distinct sampled spectral atoms. Counting the coordinate two-point differences of the already-known signed basis gives the exact ladder disjointness, number and multiplicities without a further spectral or return theorem. The frozen prior-work discussion credits the return rule but misses the exact same-path independence result.
residual_risks: The review establishes an immediate implication of prior theorems, not a claim that the exact sampling formula was printed previously. The literature search was bounded and did not establish bibliographic priority for the wording.

value.rationale: The invariant is natural and the explicit formulas can be useful for exposition, but in this particular prime path they are mechanically fixed by the previously known independent signed-basis spectrum and mean-as-atom-count theorem. Listing three signed difference types and their multiplicities supplies no independent unknown invariant under the required standard. No scientifically distinct repaired claim is established.
